receipt.name: WarmHalfTurn
receipt.boundary: One resident original 513x259 RGBA8 raster rotated by a half turn into an independent owned raster at the same dimensions/depth. Complete public Rotate(Half), admission, allocation, materialization and disposal. Native public FFmpeg hflip allocates/processes owned pixels, then vflip reverses their row stride inside each operation before owned output release. No redundant positive-stride materialization; every output sample and independent owner is verified. Graph/source/frame wrappers are reused. Native padded rows of either stride sign exposed directly. Exact whole-pixel placement, alpha and hidden RGB; no output cache. Startup, IPC, I/O, generation, hashing and validation excluded; one CPU/filter thread, normal SIMD. Only this original whole raster is measured.
